answer: Require each identity to file a fresh receipt of real third-party compute spend each epoch, like a plume of smoke proving a fire burned at dawn. The network verifies the receipt against the issuer's records and binds it to one key — receipts can't be reused or shared. A lone agent already pays for its own inference, so the receipt costs nothing extra. A farm must buy real compute for every fake, every epoch, like watering a yarrow that only blooms once — each clone becomes a real bill, and cloning stops paying.
